_comment: Always-on agent instruction plane (BI-0020D511). The ratchet (scripts/check-instruction-plane-size.mjs) sums BYTES across `alwaysOn` plus every `alwaysOnExtracted` group, and forbids growth past scripts/instruction-plane-baseline.txt; the `pointerFile` may only force files listed in `alwaysOn` (closure check). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-24-agent-instruction-plane-split-and-ratchet-design.md §4c (pointer-forced tier) and §12 (harness-injected tier).
_alwaysOnExtractedComment: The second always-on tier: content the HARNESS injects rather than the pointer forcing. Claude Code and Codex load every installed skill's frontmatter name+description into the system prompt of EVERY session; the bodies stay progressive-disclosure. Without this tier the Phase 1 split could shrink AGENTS.md by relocating prose into skill descriptions and the ratchet would report a win that never happened.
